newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Products sees Q1 loss after charges.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Products sees Q1 loss after charges.

text.p: Morgan Products Ltd said Monday it expects to report an operating profit for the first quarter but a net loss after restructuring and reorganization charges.
It reported a loss of $0.06 per share a year earlier.
The company said its financial results for the first and second quarters would be below expectations, but it expects a significant improvement in the third and fourth quarters.
Morgan said it expects to report a second quarter operating profit but only a "small" net profit after restructuring charges.
The company reported a profit of $0.17 per share in the year-ago second quarter.
Second-half results will be helped by a new high-speed door assembly line at its Oshkosh, Wis., facility, the company said.
Morgan said full-year results should show an improvement on 1996 on both an operating and net basis.
First-quarter results will be released April 30.

Late delivery of equipment for the new assembly line, plus the cost of closing a plant in Lexington, N.C., resulted in second-half 1996 charges and additional charges for the 1997 first quarter, the company said.
